Definition: , or contracted ὀστοῦν of uncertain affinity; a bone:--bone.
BiblicalUsage: Bones carry the story of death and hope. Joseph gave commandment concerning his bones, believing God would visit Israel, and John notes that not a bone of Jesus was broken, fulfilling the Scripture.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Joseph's bones are the proof of faith in a promise: he died in Egypt and still believed God would bring His people home.
